episodes.title: Baby Goat Who Could Barely Stand Grows Up To Race Her Dog Brother | The Dodo
episodes.description:

Pisa got her name from her wobbly stance, but she had no intention of staying still for long. With Susan cheering her on, the little goat grew stronger, discovered the zoomies and eventually started racing her dog brother every morning.

Dan and Louis from Wildlife Aid rescued a fallow deer who became trapped in cricket netting in the UK. Once he was safely freed, they watched him take off back into the wild and explained why discarded sports nets can be so dangerous for wildlife.

episodes.title: Woman Who's Never Had A Cat Finds Tiny Kitten In The Road | The Dodo
episodes.description:
Even first-time cat moms aren't safe from the cat distribution system 🥰🫶

Sara had never had a cat in her life until she spotted a tiny kitten alone in the middle of the road. 

She told Dodo producer Ben how she rescued him and unexpectedly became a cat mom overnight.

Kitten becomes obsessed with the beard of the man who rescued him 😂💕

Robert was just enjoying his day off when he ended up rescuing a tiny kitten whose mom had started trusting him. He told Dodo producer Ben how the little guy came into his life and developed a hilarious obsession with his beard.
